title: ONRR natural resources revenue data: federal and Native American royalties, rents, bonuses, disbursements and production
agency: U.S. Department of the Interior, Office of Natural Resources Revenue
questions: federal oil and gas royalties by state
revenue from federal lands in New Mexico or Wyoming
how much mineral revenue went to a state
oil and gas production on federal lands by year

manual.how: Open https://revenuedata.onrr.gov/downloads/ (Revenue, Disbursements or Production, then 'Downloads and documentation'), download the CSV and upload it with ingest.

cache.why: Files are refreshed monthly; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: ONRR data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of the Interior, Office of Natural Resources Revenue, {dataset}, revenuedata.onrr.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Revenue or disbursements? Revenue is what companies paid ONRR (by where the resource is); disbursements are what ONRR paid out to the Treasury, states, counties and funds. Default: revenue for 'how much came from', disbursements for 'how much a state got'.
Fiscal or calendar year? Federal fiscal years run October-September. Default: fiscal year, said as such.
